name: Truth Universally Acknowledged
source:
A new school year comes with a new student, Talay. You are Talay and Talay is you. Help him win the heart of 8 romancable characters in this whimsical school.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2920880/Truth_Universally_Acknowledged/]Steam[/url]]

新学年迎来了一名新学生塔莱。你是塔莱，塔莱就是你。帮助他在这所异想天开的学校里赢得8个浪漫角色的芳心。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2920880/Truth_Universally_Acknowledged/]Steam[/url]]
